acceptance.given: A bounded external-process or aggregate execution has a defined required coverage set.

oracle.expected: On budget exhaustion, the terminal result is unsuccessful and the coverage comparison retains every required obligation, case, Consumer, and transition.
forbidden: Reduced coverage is accepted because execution budget was exhausted.
oracle.observable: The exhausted-run terminal result and its required-coverage-set comparison, evaluated when the bounded execution completes.

acceptance.then: Budget exhaustion leaves the required coverage set unchanged.
acceptance.when: A bounded external-process or aggregate execution exhausts its budget and coverage preservation is evaluated.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Exhaust the execution budget while attempting to remove a required obligation, case, Consumer, or transition; fail if the preserved coverage comparison accepts the reduction.

slice_hint.behavior_change: On budget exhaustion, retain the complete required coverage set and report an unsuccessful deterministic terminal result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserves existing terminal categories and coverage inputs; disallows coverage reduction as a budget-exhaustion response.

slice_hint.state_transition: Complete required coverage set under bounded execution -> budget exhausted with unchanged required coverage and unsuccessful terminal result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: After budget exhaustion, the coverage comparison still includes every required obligation, case, Consumer, and transition, and the exhausted run is not accepted as successful.

acceptance.given: An Exact Cover graph contains active Atomic Obligations and mappings to assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence.

oracle.expected: Each behavioral obligation has its own observable fault witness, each other obligation has a deterministic violation witness, and every witness is independently attributable to the obligation it covers.
forbidden: A behavioral obligation lacks its own observable fault witness.
A non-behavioral obligation lacks a deterministic violation witness.
A witness is treated as covering an obligation without independently proving that obligation.
oracle.observable: Exact Cover validation reports the witness type and independently attributable witness edge for each Atomic Obligation.

acceptance.then: the graph passes only when the required witness type and independent attribution are present for every obligation.
acceptance.when: the Exact Cover validator evaluates the rebuilt coverage graph.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S7 witness assertion with one behavioral obligation missing its observable fault witness while all unrelated mappings remain intact.
Execute the S7 witness assertion with a non-behavioral obligation missing its deterministic violation witness, or with another obligation's witness reused without independent proof.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require Exact Cover witness validation to distinguish behavioral observable fault witnesses from deterministic violation witnesses and to reject witness edges that do not independently prove their mapped Atomic Obligation.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted-state or schema change; rollback restores prior Exact Cover witness-validation behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unverified witness type and attribution become independently validated per-obligation Exact Cover witness coverage, or fail closed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact Cover validation accepts only when every Atomic Obligation has its required independently attributable witness and rejects omitted, wrong-type, or non-independent witness mappings.

acceptance.given: A Stable Package is proposed for a Matrix Case before either subject executes.

oracle.expected: The eligibility record contains verifiable source provenance and an immutable Stable identity bound before execution.
forbidden: A temporary package accepted as Stable merely because it differs from Candidate.
Stable eligibility without a pre-run immutable identity.
oracle.observable: The Stable eligibility record and pre-execution identity binding evaluated by the SM-6 selector.

acceptance.then: Only a source-qualified Stable subject with its immutable identity pre-bound is eligible for the Matrix Case.
acceptance.when: The SM-6 selector evaluates Stable eligibility before Matrix Case execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove or alter the Stable provenance or pre-run immutable identity and require the eligibility selector to reject the subject.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require verifiable source-supported provenance and a pre-run immutable identity before Stable eligibility; reject a temporary differing package as Stable.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore Stable eligibility validation without promoting a quality baseline or changing Candidate identity semantics.

slice_hint.state_transition: Stable provenance eligibility not required -> only pre-run source-qualified immutable Stable subjects are eligible
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Before any Matrix execution, the selector accepts Stable only with verifiable provenance and the immutable identity bound; missing, changed, or temporary-subject identity is rejected.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result succeeds for an input whose Validator Capability is independently evaluable.

oracle.expected: The replay result includes a Validator Capability verification outcome produced for that result, independently of other replay verifications.
forbidden: A successful Replay Result whose Validator Capability verification is inferred from another verification.
oracle.observable: The successful replay result's per-result Validator Capability verification outcome.

acceptance.then: The successful Replay Result carries its own Validator Capability verification outcome.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S24 replay behavior test with a successful replay whose Validator Capability outcome is omitted or borrowed; the runtime assertion must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require each successful replay result to independently verify and expose its Validator Capability outcome.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Restore prior replay-result verification handling without changing the capability descriptor schema.

slice_hint.state_transition: successful replay without independent capability verification -> successful replay with a per-result independent capability outcome
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S24 selector rejects a successful replay that lacks its own Validator Capability verification.
